subject: Integrating Shiny to a new Package

messages.author: 7e553b1dbda2bf3f
messages.subject: Integrating Shiny to a new Package
parts:
Hello,
We are actually trying to mix Shiny with the FactoMineR package. We used this function in our package :

runMyApp <- function() {
  shiny::runApp(system.file("myapp", package="mypackage"))
}

We would like our function to take an argument, data, and that our app uses the data to work.
I explain myself : our shiny app should be able to work for any database. Then, our runMyApp function needs to inform the app about which database it should use.
We don't know how to make the link between the runMyApp function and the server.R file in "myapp".

Thank you very much for your help,

Pauline and Astrid
